A.name: Ground-truth provenance and official exclusion
details: The dataset loader parses identity/camera from dataset filenames, retains original query/gallery identities and subtracts one from camera numbers. Labels are not generated from model predictions.

Independently checked all 10,290 cached query/gallery names against cached IDs/cameras and all 3,430 saved original/AV query rows against those metadata. Names are unique and sorted within each split; scenes are -1.

The independent ranking removes only same-identity AND same-camera gallery entries, matching the official-style scorer. Every query excludes 25 entries, keeps 8,550 and has 50 to 175 eligible positives. Same-camera different-identity negatives remain eligible.

Cached00 is the retained AV frozen original-teacher state. Its provenance record identifies original DeMo seed42 epoch8; the state writer uses the frozen00 feature branch and checks anchor equality/tensor versions. Its complete ranking agrees with the historical original per-query metrics. This is not a new independent original-binary inference.
scope_limits: Current remote dataset images/directories and original checkpoint tensors were not reopened. This is a local saved-metadata/protocol/ranking audit; frozen-weight execution remains qualified historical provenance.

B.name: Score normalization and manipulation
details: Each margin is the unscaled nearest-negative squared distance minus nearest-positive squared distance. The change is AV margin minus cached00 margin. Every distance and margin field matches raw float32 values exactly after Python float conversion.

AP divides precision sums by the dataset-relevant count, INP uses relevant count / last-positive rank, and CMC divides correct-query counts by valid-query count. Multiplication by 100 is a fixed percentage conversion. No reported metric denominator uses the model prediction maximum, minimum or mean.

The auditor independently sorted the full eligible gallery for every query/state and recomputed AP, INP, first/last positive ranks and CMC. Maximum per-query AP difference from saved CSV is 4.440892098500626e-16; INP and last ranks match exactly. Feature L2 normalization is a representation choice, not self-normalized performance.

All 29,412,250 examined distances are finite. There are no positive-vs-negative nearest-distance ties or nearest-positive/nearest-negative ties in either state. Stable gallery-index tie ordering matches the scorer.

C.name: Files, numbers, coverage and execution claims
details: All 18 listed artifacts exist, were read directly and match the request byte counts/SHA-256. The request and all 18 inputs are unchanged before and after the audit and at final report creation.

The retained archive is 397,604,472 bytes with SHA-256 9ed30d96dfa334c7749cb3880b01c03352b8dbe6b99c0fa88bfba5a788ce4be6, matching both completed intake and analysis result. Both selected matrices are complete 1,715 x 8,575 float32 arrays.

Independent full-gallery ranking covers 3,430 query-states and exactly matches all 72,030 fields in the 1,715-row, 42-column output CSV. The 3,430 historical rows have matching GT metadata, valid flags, eligible/relevant counts, first/last ranks, Rank-1/5/10/20, AP and INP within stated numeric precision.

All four complete cohort summaries match: both_wrong 49 queries/14 identities, rescued_by_AV 9/5, harmed_by_AV 6/4, both_correct 1651/50. Every camera set, count, mean, median, minimum, maximum, p10/p90, margin-improvement count and AP-improvement count agrees.

All 23 selected case records match all fields and order: 14 both-wrong identities, 5 rescued identities and 4 harmed identities. Each is the lowest query index for that identity within its cohort. This is 23 cohort/identity cases, not 23 distinct independent identities.

Historical six-metric values match saved per-query reductions, best_per_query JSON and run best/full_metrics. CMC1..50 and all identity/camera/scene group metrics also match. Both referenced historical runs record COMPLETE. Their neural execution is not newly repeated or inferred from elapsed time.

The analyzer result reports zero new neural calls/optimizer updates/fitting/progress queries. Its static call path and the independently reproduced artifact values support the CPU saved-analysis scope. The auditor did not rerun analyzer main or collector main.

D.name: Called computation and collector source
details: Analyzer main reads the fixed archive and saved query tables, calls margins for cached00 and full11 for every query, calls distribution for every cohort, and writes the CSV/selection/result. The imported load/query_rows/table helper is stdlib-only and has no import-time main execution. Independently reproduced outputs match these reachable computations.

The historical trainer evaluate path calls full_evaluation.full_metrics, which calls evaluate_reid and writes per-query CSV/JSON. The AV state writer also calls full_metrics and writes distances_00/distances to the saved archive. utils.metrics has legacy/visualization helpers, but none is the source of these new margin claims.

The collector consumes the fixed selected_visual_cases.json without reselection. Query images resolve to query/ and wrong/correct images to bounding_box_test/ under the RGBNT100/rgbir dataset root. Selected wrong names equal the corresponding state top1; correct names are nearest eligible positives using original for harmed cases and AV for the other cases.

Collector source uses the current Triplets RGB/NI/TI montage order, enforces 768x128 decoded RGB images, and pastes whole images without resizing. Captions/dividers are outside the image area. The SSH body disables CUDA and imports PIL but no model/Torch; imported collect_results contributes OPTIONS and does not run its collector main.

The source checks basenames, records original source hashes, verifies copied sheet bytes/hashes and removes only the newly created named diagnostic sheet directory after local verification. It does not write dataset images, weights, training state or current progress files.

Collector execution and visual image content are not audited here. No actual collection receipt is an input; no image-fetch, pixel-content, perceptual error-category or human-evaluation claim is supported by this source review.

E.name: Historical-vs-new scope and claim ceilings
details: The new work is a complete saved-data diagnosis on one RGBNT100 normal-input query/gallery split: two cached states over the same 1,715 queries and 8,575 gallery entries. It adds zero neural experiments, training runs, optimizer updates or fitted parameters.

The original seed42 model was selected at epoch8 from 50 epochs; AV axis seed42 was selected at epoch20 after an additional50 stage from that teacher. Both selected maximum official query/gallery mAP. All six metrics in each row refer to its single historical selected checkpoint.

The reported original/AV six values are inherited historical results, independently verified from saved arrays/tables here. They are benchmark-selected, not an untouched final test. Recounting the full saved matrices does not remove checkpoint selection or repeated-benchmark exposure.

The diagnostic sample is deterministic but label-selected and concentrated by error cohort/identity. It cannot establish random-sample prevalence, causal failure mechanism, local-frequency repair efficacy, deployable ground-truth routing, missing-modality performance, multiple-seed stability or other-dataset generalization.

The analyzer and selection file explicitly state these limits. The unexecuted collector/visual stage and same-family provisional review are scope qualifications, not numerical defects requiring a source fix.

F.name: Evaluation type
details: Retrieval correctness, nearest-positive/negative labels, first-match ranks and error cohorts use dataset identity/camera GT: real_gt, with offline diagnostic scope.

Using cached00 teacher distances as a reference state does not make identity GT model-generated. Teacher equality and input-hash equality are consistency checks, not substitute identity labels or additional independent accuracy experiments.

The selected list is a real-GT label-selected diagnostic sample. It is not human_eval: no images or human visual judgments were supplied or executed in this audit. No simulation or self-supervised proxy score is being reported.
